name: Golden Gate Bridge
description: Stage 3 — roadway: six marked lanes, segmented movable median, bypass sidewalks around tower legs, open railings, twin curved-arm Art Deco lamps; ground-terminated anchorages with stepped chevron pylons. GPU deck/anchorage/bypass inspected. 322,220 triangles before final optimization; color tuning remains.
